name: Penicillin
description: Scotch sour with honey-ginger warmth (built for your honey syrup).
whyItWorks: Honey and lemon frame Scotch; a float of richer Scotch adds aroma.

ingredients.notes: Use a blend; optional smoky float

steps: Shake Scotch, lemon, and honey syrup with ice.
Optional: float a barspoon of smokier Scotch if you have it.
techniqueNotes: Classic Penicillin uses ginger syrup; honey syrup still makes a delicious house version.

recommendedBottles.rationale: A strong match from your bar.
